inputs.text: Phoenix’s leaders are putting political posturing ahead of cooperation with the people responsible for enforcing the law. Whatever procedural language surrounds this vote, restricting ICE and other law enforcement agencies from using city property risks undermining public order. Families need safe communities and officials who respect the rule of law—not leaders who make enforcement harder.
